words.w: let the chips fall where they may
words.vi: Để mọi việc diễn ra tự nhiên mà không cần kiểm soát
words.en: To let things happen naturally without control
words.ex: I've done my best – let the chips fall where they may.

words.w: where there's a will, there's a way
words.vi: Quyết tâm có thể vượt qua mọi trở ngại
words.ex: He finally finished the degree at 50 – where there's a will, there's a way.

words.vi: Những gì bạn làm quan trọng hơn những gì bạn nói
words.en: What you do matters more than what you say
words.ex: He promised to change, but actions speak louder than words.

words.w: don't judge a book by its cover
words.vi: Đừng đánh giá dựa trên vẻ bề ngoài
words.ex: He looks scary but is very kind – don't judge a book by its cover.

words.w: the grass is always greener on the other side
words.vi: Những tình huống khác luôn có vẻ tốt hơn tình huống của bạn
words.en: Other situations always seem better than your own
words.ex: She quit her job thinking the grass was greener elsewhere.

words.vi: Thà làm điều gì đó muộn còn hơn là không làm gì cả
words.en: It's better to do something late than not at all
words.ex: He finally apologized – better late than never.

words.w: don't put all your eggs in one basket
words.vi: Đừng mạo hiểm mọi thứ vào một kế hoạch
words.en: Don't risk everything on one plan
words.ex: Diversify your investments – don't put all your eggs in one basket.

words.w: out of sight, out of mind
words.vi: Những điều không nhìn thấy rất dễ bị lãng quên
words.en: Things not seen are easily forgotten
words.ex: After moving away, we lost touch – out of sight, out of mind.

words.vi: Mỗi hành động đều dẫn đến một kết quả
words.en: Every action leads to a result
words.ex: He learned that actions have consequences after being fined.

words.w: two wrongs don't make a right
words.vi: Trả lời sai trả lời sai không giải quyết được gì
words.en: Responding to wrong with wrong doesn't fix anything
words.ex: Don't retaliate – two wrongs don't make a right.

words.w: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
words.vi: Thích nghi với phong tục của nơi bạn đang ở
words.en: Adapt to the customs of the place you're in
words.ex: I tried the local dish – when in Rome, do as the Romans do.

words.vi: Thực hành lặp đi lặp lại cải thiện kỹ năng
Việc làm quan trọng hơn lời hứa
words.ex: He proved his commitment – actions are louder than words.

words.vi: Mọi người đều có cơ hội thành công cuối cùng
words.en: Everyone gets a chance to succeed eventually
words.ex: Don't give up – every dog has its day.

words.w: the early bird gets the worm
words.vi: Thành công đến với những người hành động sớm
words.en: Success comes to those who act early
words.ex: We left at dawn – the early bird gets the worm.

words.w: don't count your chickens before they hatch
words.vi: Đừng cho rằng thành công trước khi nó chắc chắn
words.en: Don't assume success before it's certain
words.ex: We haven't won yet – don't count your chickens.

words.vi: Quá tò mò có thể dẫn đến rắc rối
words.en: Being too curious can lead to trouble
words.ex: Stop asking questions – curiosity killed the cat.

words.w: absence makes the heart grow fonder
words.vi: Xa nhau làm tăng thêm tình cảm
words.ex: We missed each other so much – absence makes the heart grow fonder.
